domain: Every characteristic-zero field. Exact/log separation over its algebraic closure; unit-center odd-cubic phases p=t/x*(C+t^2D). Prime exclusion assumes exactly one double geometric root of C and all remaining geometric roots simple.

retained_resources.exact_use: All-order endpoint criterion and arbitrary characteristic-zero rational-u descent for regular unit-center odd-cubic phases.
Audited norm-logarithmic-derivative proof and least-degree normal-form comparison; the new exact/log lemma is proved directly.
Exact bilinears and factorial/angular normalization used by the original-contraction controls.
Remark5.47 norm/trace products; Theorem9.19 Luroth ONLY for the optional general intermediate-field reduction, not for the one-double-root prime exclusion.

self_contained_arguments: Function-field exact/log separation via trace to the rational field generated by the hypothetical nonconstant exact primitive.
Equivalence splitting every pure odd-cubic endpoint identity into its rational-primitive and logarithmic parts.
Degree-one rational primitive forces Mobius involution; derivative normalization Q0=1; finite-alpha composite degree.
Reflection excluded by invariant regular differential at infinity; inversion exhaustively gives qmultiple4 and even degree.
